Implemented GET /api/v1/crawl and GET /api/v1/collections/{c}/crawl?path=&depth= in internal/api/crawl.go (design/04 §7, design/05 §5). Policy-filtered: private/expired objects (and anything under a private ancestor) never listed regardless of scope; non-crawlable objects omitted unless the token has admin scope; unlisted/protected objects ARE included (crawl API is distinct from human directory listing, SPEC §9/§10.1). depth defaults to 1, negative = unlimited recursion. Added scripts/smoke-test.sh check exercising the real spawned server. Branch claude/artifactsd-s56/crawl-api pushed from main (origin/main already has c4f+3jd merged). PR not yet opened — gh CLI unavailable in this environment; use https://github.com/jdelic/artifactsd/pull/new/claude/artifactsd-s56/crawl-api. make check + make smoke green. Implemented GET /robots.txt in internal/serve/robots.go (design/05 §3, SPEC §10.3): Disallow /api/ + admin path, per-collection Allow/Disallow by effective crawl.indexable (private/unlisted always disallowed), Sitemap: line when any collection allowed. Cached in-memory with a short fixed TTL. Deliberately DROPPED the originally-spec'd GET /c/{collection}/robots.txt during implementation after Jonas flagged it: RFC 9309 only recognizes robots.txt at the domain root, so a per-collection one would never be honored by a real crawler. Updated SPEC.md §10.3 and design/05 §3 to match the corrected scope. make check + make smoke green (smoke check updated accordingly). Branch claude/artifactsd-8gd/robots-txt pushed from main. Implemented artifactsd mcp: Streamable HTTP transport via the official github.com/modelcontextprotocol/go-sdk (E3: stable at build time), its own --listen/--base-url/--token config (internal/config/mcp.go, decoupled from the main server's storage/TLS/admin settings), internal/mcp.New wiring an apiclient.Client for tool handlers, and internal/mcp.MapError for actionable error mapping (design/11 §5). No tools registered yet — that's artifactsd-0gt via gosdk.AddTool. Covered by an end-to-end transport test (real MCP client connects, initializes, lists tools), config validation tests, and a runMCP start/shutdown test. Implemented all 10 SPEC §16 tools on the MCP server: artifact_create_collection, put_text, begin_upload, get/set_metadata, delete, list_tree, get_public_url, create_share, get_crawl_tree. Each calls the management API via pkg/apiclient and maps errors through MapError. Found and worked around an SDK schema-inference gotcha: json.RawMessage metadata fields get inferred as byte-array schemas (not objects), which fails the SDK's own output validation at runtime — added CollectionOut/FileMetaOut wrappers and a map[string]any input for set_metadata instead. Added apiclient.BeginUpload (didn't exist yet). Covered by an end-to-end test driving all ten tools as a real MCP client against a real artifactsd instance (internal/testserver).
